description: Placed geometry: an off-centre circle with a specified radius.
prompt: Write a GLSL ES 3.0 fragment shader implementing mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord). iResolution (vec3) and iTime (float) are provided; do not redeclare them and do not write main(). Use normalized coordinates with origin at the bottom-left. Requirements: (1) draw one filled red circle centered at (0.30, 0.65); (2) its radius is 0.18 of frame height; (3) use a near-black background and a hard boundary; (4) the shader is static and ignores iTime; (5) no NaN output.
